projectDescription: A Minecraft Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds baking, brewing, and fermentation gameplay including new crops, cheeses, jams, mead varieties, and feast dishes.
keyFeatures: New crops: barley, rye, ginger, garlic, mint, elderberries, rose hips, hawthorn berries, and lemon trees
Keg block for brewing 6+ varieties of mead with unique potion effects
Cheese Press block for crafting four cheese wheel types (Freshwheel, Duskwheel, Sharpwheel, and basic Cheese Wheel)
Tree Tap block for harvesting maple syrup from maple trees
10+ jam varieties craftable from fruits and berries in jars
Rich feast dishes (bowls and plates) that grant the custom Overfed and Vigorous mob effects
Full Maple wood set including logs, planks, stairs, slabs, doors, boats, and signs
Custom Tavern Keeper villager profession tied to the Keg block
World generation additions including maple, lemon, and hawthorn trees plus structures
Compatibility with Farmer's Delight, Hexalia, and Farm and Charm mods
publicApiSurface: ModItems — registry of all mod items (yeast, crops, foods, meads, jams, cheeses, wood items)
ModBlocks — registry of all mod blocks (crops, functional blocks, cheese wheels, maple wood set)
ModRecipes — KegRecipe and CheesePressRecipe custom recipe serializers
ModMobEffects — Overfed (slows movement, prevents saturation loss) and Vigorous (+6 max health, improved healing) effects
ModVillagers — Tavern Keeper villager profession with Keg as work block
ModFoodProperties — nutrition and saturation values for all food items
